newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Diana arrives in Pakistan to help cancer hospital.
newsitem.headline: Diana arrives in Pakistan to help cancer hospital.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana arrived in Pakistan on Thursday on a three-day visit to help raise funds for a cancer hospital in Lahore, capital of the central province of Punjab.
The visit is her second to Pakistan in 15 months to help the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Hospital built by former cricket captain Imran Khan.
Diana is expected to attend a tea party on Friday and a dinner the next day to raise funds for the hospital.
The princess last visited Lahore in February 1996 before Imran launched his Tehrik-i-Insaaf party, which failed to win any parliamentary seats in general elections held in February.
